candidate.blueprint_locator: Health Promotion and Maintenance — healthy lifestyle, coping, and wellness education
candidate.blueprint_topic: Health Promotion and Maintenance — stress management
candidate.educational_objective: Identify evidence-based health behaviors that support stress management and well-being.

options.A: Include regular physical activity, adequate sleep, relaxation practices, and connection with supportive people.
options.B: Wait for the stressor to disappear without using deliberate coping or recovery strategies.
options.C: Avoid physical activity during stressful periods to conserve energy for work.
options.D: Use caffeine and alcohol as primary strategies to manage stress and sleep.

candidate.rationale: Current CDC stress-management guidance recommends caring for the body with adequate sleep and physical activity, taking time to unwind with practices such as deep breathing or meditation, and connecting with trusted people or community supports. A is correct.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Stress management includes adequate sleep, physical activity, relaxation/unwinding practices, and supportive social connection.
candidate.source_locator: Take care of your body; Make time to unwind; Connect with others
candidate.source_organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)
candidate.stem: Which self-care plan should the nurse recommend to an adult experiencing ongoing work-related stress?
